text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: elevated gateway 5xx + timeouts observed in eu-west-1 for route /v1/generate. 5xx ~18%, p95 latency >3s. Paging current oncall @tony. Links: https://metrics.company/gateway?region=eu-west-1 :rotating_light:

ton y: ack -- looking. any recent deploys?

maya: none in last 45m, I'm pulling scheduler/batcher metrics now.

neil: seeing batcher queue depth spike 200 -> 1600 in ~3m. lots of old batches stuck HEAD-OF-LINE; KV cache miss rate jump too.

tony: ok starting runbook "batch-headblock-unblock". @deploy-bot please start fallback reroute for /v1/generate to fallback-pool-2, 10% then 30%.

deploy-bot: cmd: /reroute route=/v1/generate from=eu-west-1 to=fallback-pool-2 percent=10 --accepted
Result: gradual shift initiated (~30s to 10%).

maya: running eviction to clear stuck batches: `/scripts/evict_stalled.sh --age 45s`
logs:
```
[evict] 2026-03-15T02:01:12Z evicted 412 batches from worker-12
[evict] 2026-03-15T02:01:13Z evicted 89 batches from worker-07
[evict] freed ~28k cached tokens
```

cs-jane: CS note — customer Dataly reported timeouts in EU live chat. Ticket #1209 opened. Marked high impact.

ton y: scaling immediate: `kscale batcher-service --replicas +4` (target 12). watching CPU and queue.

neil: also toggling batching window to reduce HOL blocking: posting config patch now: `batching.window_ms: 50 -> 20` (applied via config-service).

maya: metrics update: after eviction + 10% reroute p50 down to 320ms, 5xx -> 6%. Deploy-bot advancing reroute to 30%.

deploy-bot: reroute update: 30% traffic now shifted.

ton y: handing oncall to maya for follow-up. I'm updating incident page and coordinating infra to check KV thrash.

maya: taking over. Action items: 1) keep reroute until p95 < 1s for 10m, 2) monitor cache miss and evictions, 3) run canary requests to validate correctness.

neil: root-cause hypothesis: sudden increase in long-lived streaming requests caused incomplete batch formation, which amplified per-worker backlog creating head-of-line blocking on worker-12 hotspot.

maya: applied temporary streaming throttle flag: `streaming.max_pending = 8` in eu-west at 02:05 UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout done: streaming flag flip at 02:05 UTC (trace: trace://ab12cd).

cs-jane: Customer impact update — Dataly reports sessions recovered, timeouts resolved for their internal tests. CS to follow up with formal communication.

maya: current metrics: 5xx 3.2% (down), p95 820ms and trending down. Keeping reroute at 10% for an observation window.

ton y: thanks team. I'll remain available but handing incident to maya. Recommend postmortem once stabilized to dig deeper into why eviction cadence didn't prevent HOL.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to P2. Incident triage doc: https://wiki/runbooks/batch-hol-unblock. oncall: maya -> monitoring window 30m. :white_check_mark: 

maya: note for postmortem: examine worker-12 telemetry, batching size distribution, and KV cache eviction TTLs. I'll capture logs and schedule RCA meeting.

tony: closing paging loop from oncall side at 02:20 UTC; handoff complete. continuing passive watch.

m aya: (follow-up) rolling back temporary flags after steady state: streaming.max_pending -> default at 02:45 UTC. Final verification shows stable latency and 5xx ~1.2%.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: primary mitigations (eviction + reroute + scaling + streaming throttle) removed risk. Postmortem planned.
